content.short: Chainsafe is an R&D Web3 company building protocols, Web3 games, and interoperability.
content.description: Chainsafe provides a Web3 game development suite along with a secure decentralized file storage system backed by the Filecoin network. The storage service enables encryption-protected file storage in a decentralized model, offering an alternative to centralized hosting. Developers can use the Web3.Unity tool to create in-game marketplaces, mint NFT assets, and implement a broad range of blockchain-enabled features. This solution supports multi-network development across Ethereum, Polkadot, BNB Chain, Multichain, and Solana, enabling rich, interconnected experiences.
